respuesta.pregunta: In order-workflow-api 5.6.2-hotfix-1, how do I abort a pipeline that's already running? What's the sequence of calls between the services when it gets aborted?
respuesta.respuesta:
I can't answer this from the 5.6.2-hotfix-1 documentation. None of the documents for that version say how a pipeline is aborted or which calls happen between services when it is.

The only pipeline flow the docs describe step by step is validation, and it has its own sequence diagram [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/use-cases.md:L109-L168]. In that flow, the Orchestrator starts the validation through BigQ, and the Workflow API then requests the pipeline information from the Orchestrator [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/use-cases.md:L119-L125]. The abort sequence may follow a similar pattern, but the docs don't describe it, so I can't tell you what it looks like.
